records.title: Engineering Knowledge
records.differentiating_characteristic: Breadth, depth and type of knowledge, both theoretical and practical
records.text: Apply knowledge of mathematics, natural science, computing and engineering fundamentals, and an engineering specialization as specified in WK1 to WK4 respectively to develop solutions to complex engineering problems
records.embed_text: Engineering Knowledge. Apply knowledge of mathematics, natural science, computing and engineering fundamentals, and an engineering specialization as specified in WK1 to WK4 respectively to develop solutions to complex engineering problems. Differentiating characteristic: Breadth, depth and type of knowledge, both theoretical and practical. Explicit WK links: WK-1, WK-2, WK-3, WK-4. Range and context: Complex engineering problems

records.title: Problem Analysis
records.text: Identify, formulate, research literature and analyze complex engineering problems reaching substantiated conclusions using first principles of mathematics, natural sciences and engineering sciences with holistic considerations for sustainable development
records.embed_text: Problem Analysis. Identify, formulate, research literature and analyze complex engineering problems reaching substantiated conclusions using first principles of mathematics, natural sciences and engineering sciences with holistic considerations for sustainable development. Differentiating characteristic: Complexity of analysis. Explicit WK links: WK-1, WK-2, WK-3, WK-4. Range and context: Complex engineering problems

records.title: Design/development of solutions
records.differentiating_characteristic: Breadth and uniqueness of engineering problems, i.e. the extent to which problems are original and to which solutions have not previously been identified or codified
records.text: Design creative solutions for complex engineering problems and design systems, components or processes to meet identified needs with appropriate consideration for public health and safety, whole-life cost, net zero carbon as well as resource, cultural, societal, and environmental considerations as required
records.embed_text: Design/development of solutions. Design creative solutions for complex engineering problems and design systems, components or processes to meet identified needs with appropriate consideration for public health and safety, whole-life cost, net zero carbon as well as resource, cultural, societal, and environmental considerations as required. Differentiating characteristic: Breadth and uniqueness of engineering problems, i.e. the extent to which problems are original and to which solutions have not previously been identified or codified. Explicit WK links: WK-5. Range and context: Complex engineering problems

records.title: Investigation
records.differentiating_characteristic: Breadth and depth of investigation and experimentation
records.text: Conduct investigations of complex engineering problems using research methods including research-based knowledge, design of experiments, analysis and interpretation of data, and synthesis of information to provide valid conclusions
records.embed_text: Investigation. Conduct investigations of complex engineering problems using research methods including research-based knowledge, design of experiments, analysis and interpretation of data, and synthesis of information to provide valid conclusions. Differentiating characteristic: Breadth and depth of investigation and experimentation. Explicit WK links: WK-8. Range and context: Complex engineering problems

records.title: Tool Usage
records.differentiating_characteristic: Level of understanding of the appropriateness of technologies and tools
records.text: Create, select and apply, and recognize limitations of appropriate techniques, resources, and modern engineering and IT tools, including prediction and modelling, to complex engineering problems
records.embed_text: Tool Usage. Create, select and apply, and recognize limitations of appropriate techniques, resources, and modern engineering and IT tools, including prediction and modelling, to complex engineering problems. Differentiating characteristic: Level of understanding of the appropriateness of technologies and tools. Explicit WK links: WK-2, WK-6. Range and context: Complex engineering problems

records.title: The Engineer and the World
records.differentiating_characteristic: Level of knowledge and responsibility for sustainable development
records.text: When solving complex engineering problems, analyze and evaluate sustainable development impacts to society, the economy, sustainability, health and safety, legal frameworks, and the environment
records.embed_text: The Engineer and the World. Differentiating characteristic: Level of knowledge and responsibility for sustainable development. Explicit WK links: WK-1, WK-5, WK-7. Range and context: Complex engineering problems

records.title: Ethics
records.text: Apply ethical principles and commit to professional ethics and norms of engineering practice and adhere to relevant national and international laws. Demonstrate an understanding of the need for diversity and inclusion
records.embed_text: Ethics. Apply ethical principles and commit to professional ethics and norms of engineering practice and adhere to relevant national and international laws. Demonstrate an understanding of the need for diversity and inclusion. Differentiating characteristic: Understanding and level of practice. Explicit WK links: WK-9. Range and context: Ethics / laws / diversity and inclusion

records.title: Individual and Collaborative Teamwork
records.differentiating_characteristic: Role in and diversity of team
records.text: Function effectively as an individual, and as a member or leader in diverse and inclusive teams and in multi-disciplinary, face-to-face, remote and distributed settings
records.embed_text: Individual and Collaborative Teamwork. records.title: Communication
records.differentiating_characteristic: Level of communication according to type of activities performed
records.text: Communicate effectively and inclusively on complex engineering activities with the engineering community and with society at large, such as being able to comprehend and write effective reports and design documentation, make effective presentations, taking into account cultural, language, and learning differences
records.embed_text: Communication. records.title: Project Management and Finance
records.differentiating_characteristic: Level of management required for differing types of activity
records.text: Apply knowledge and understanding of engineering management principles and economic decision-making and apply these to one’s own work, as a member and leader in a team, and to manage projects and in multidisciplinary environments
records.embed_text: Project Management and Finance. records.title: Lifelong Learning
records.range_context: Lifelong learning / emerging technologies / critical thinking
records.text: Recognize the need for, and have the preparation and ability for: (i) independent and life-long learning; (ii) adaptability to new and emerging technologies; and (iii) critical thinking in the broadest context of technological change
records.embed_text: Lifelong Learning. Recognize the need for, and have the preparation and ability for: (i) independent and life-long learning; (ii) adaptability to new and emerging technologies; and (iii) critical thinking in the broadest context of technological change. Differentiating characteristic: Duration and manner. Explicit WK links: WK-8. Range and context: Lifelong learning / emerging technologies / critical thinking
